source_mechanic: Tile-match 3D: pick matching objects from an occluded heap into a seven-slot tray; triples clear and seven unmatched objects lose.
transformation: Curio Tray is an original 2D layered cabinet with procedural stacks of illustrated curios, independent geometry-based exposure, a persistent seven-slot tray, triple clearing, and replay grading. It does not reuse commercial art, levels, code, or presentation.
assets: All icons, colors, layout, geometry, and interaction code are original HTML/CSS/JavaScript rendering.
limitations: The cited survey record and source pages establish the generic browser mechanic and controls, not this implementation's stack geometry or difficulty calibration. Human and computer-use-agent calibration remains unperformed.
